telemetry_disclosure.answer: The privacy policy discloses first-party analytics on opencode.ai, docs and Console and covers hosted services only. Desktop (v2.3.2): the release workflow passes a repository variable as the Sentry DSN for every desktop build, and the official Linux desktop package embeds a populated DSN, so that build sends error reports; macOS and Windows packages were not inspected. Web client: Sentry initializes only when built with a DSN, and no release workflow sets one. OTLP export runs only when the user configures an endpoint. No product-usage telemetry was found in the CLI, and no in-client telemetry disclosure is documented.
